NationalParkLassText:
Look! Check out my
bag!

I printed out my
favorites from my

#DEX and stuck
them on my bag.
NationalParkPokefanFText:
This is MAIL I got
from my daughter. It cheers me up.
NationalParkTeacher1Text:
Pay attention,
please!

…Oops, I have to
quit thinking like

a teacher all the
time.

You must be a
#MON trainer.

Since you're work-
ing so hard, I

want you to have
this.
NationalParkTeacher1Text_GotQuickClaw:
Let a #MON hold
that QUICK CLAW.

Sometimes it will
strike first during battle.
NationalParkYoungster1Text:
I'm playing with
stickers I printed from my #DEX.
NationalParkYoungster2Text:
I get the other
guy's #DEX sticker if I win.
NationalParkTeacher2Text:
I take walks in
the PARK, but I

never go into the
grass.

Trainers always
want to battle…
NationalParkGameboyKidText:
I'm printing out
my #DEX.

You can also print
out stuff like

MAIL and your PC
BOXES.
SchoolboyJack1SeenText:
The world of
#MON is deep.

There are still
lots of things we don't know.

But I know more
than you do!
SchoolboyJackTradeMonText:
There is a lot
to learn.

For example…

There are {d:NUM_TMS} kinds
of TMs.

Traded #MON
level up faster.
PokefanfBeverly1SeenText:
My #MON are
simply darling.

Let me tell you
how proud my darlings make me.
PokefanfBeverly1BeatenText:
I can beat you in
pride, but…
PokefanBeverlyCuteMonText:
I must say, your
#MON are quite cute, too.
PokefanmWilliamSeenText:
We adore our #-
MON, even if they dislike us.

That's what being
a FAN is about.
PokefanmWilliamAfterBattleText:
I lost the battle,
but my #MON win

the prize for
being most lovely.
PokefanFBeverlyMarillFriendText:
My friend keeps a
MARILL!

I find them very
endearing.

Oh, I wish for a
MARILL of my own…
LassKriseSeenText:
Hello? Why are you
staring at me?

Oh, a battle?
LassKriseAfterBattleText:
I thought you were
staring at me because I'm cute!
NationalParkBattleNoticeText:
What is this
notice?

Please battle only
in the grass.

NATIONAL PARK
WARDEN'S OFFICE
NationalParkTrainerTipsText:
TRAINER TIPS

Print out MAIL by
opening it then pressing START.
